name: @threatforest/workspace
description: ThreatForest TypeScript migration workspace (engine, server, cli, web).

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @threatforest/types && tsc -b packages/engine packages/server packages/cli packages/mcp-server packages/control-plane packages/hosted-runtime packages/ingestion packages/infra
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:web
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @threatforest/server
scripts.verify:hosted: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:web
